sources.title: Theory of Dark Matter Superfluidity
sources.verified_implication: Their phonon vertex is proportional to total baryon mass density. The galaxy/cluster distinction is a phase of the dark medium, based on its density and velocity dispersion. It is not a rule omitting hot baryons within a superfluid region. The baryon vertex and constitutive action are assumed model ingredients.
